description: This file defines the StatementWrapperIterator class, which extends StatementBase, and implements an iterator for database statement execution within Drupal's database abstraction layer. It manages PDO statements, fetch modes, and execution events.

classes.name: StatementWrapperIterator
classes.description: An iterator implementation for database statement execution, handling PDO statements and fetch modes within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with database connection, query, options, and row count setting.

methods.name: getClientStatement
methods.description: Returns the PDO statement object; throws exception if not initialized.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the statement with optional arguments and options, manages fetch modes, and handles execution events.
